name: Venture OS — Capture
description: Capture the LinkedIn profile you are viewing into Venture OS. Reads a page when you ask it to — from the popup, or when Venture OS requests one. Never posts, messages or acts for you.
_comment_host_permissions: media.licdn.com only, and only so the SERVICE WORKER can fetch avatar image bytes. A profile photo URL is signed and time-limited and refuses an unauthenticated server-side fetch, and an in-page fetch is blocked by CORS — the diagnostics recorded 'fetch:Failed to fetch' on every capture. A service-worker request carries no page origin, so it is the one context that can retrieve the bytes. Images only; nothing is read from any page here.
